source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of data preparation (PDF 133).

blocks.text: Jama karne ke baad data tayyar karna zaroori hai: ghaltiyon aur be-rabti se saaf, ba-maani tarteeb mein aur munasib shakal mein. Jahan data ghayab ya ghalat ho wahan interpolation ya statistical adjustment jaise tareeqe istemal ho sakte hain; maslan survey ke ghayab jawab dastiyab data se andaze se bhare ja sakte hain. Durust tayyari analysis ko qabil-e-aitbaar aur sahih banati hai.

blocks.prompt: Data ki tayyari ke teen kaam bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Ghaltiyan aur be-rabti saaf karna, data ko ba-maani tarteeb dena, aur analysis ke liye munasib shakal mein badalna (ghayab qeematein sambhalna).

items: Tayyari: saaf karna, tarteeb dena, badalna; ghayab data sambhalna ta ke nataij qabil-e-aitbaar hon.
